figs.name: signals-in-instrumentation-ai-ao-di-do-loop-diagram
figs.alt: AI AO DI DO signals diagram with transmitter, limit switch, valve positioner and motor starter
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing analog and digital input and output signals between field devices and a PLC: transmitter, limit switch, valve positioner and motor starter.

<text x="675.0" y="305.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">positioner</text>
<line x1="472" y1="290" x2="568" y2="288" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="520" y="278" font-size="16" fill="#065f46" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">4 to 20 mA</text>

<text x="400" y="440" font-size="18" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Analog signals carry a range of values; digital signals carry ON or OFF.</text>

figs.name: signals-in-instrumentation-4-to-20-ma-scaling-infographic
figs.alt: 4 to 20 mA analog input scaling chart for a 0 to 10 bar pressure transmitter
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing how a PLC scales a 4 to 20 mA analog input to 0 to 10 bar, with 12 mA equal to 5 bar.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 430" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>4 to 20 mA analog input scaling chart for a 0 to 10 bar transmitter</title>
<rect width="800" height="430" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#065f46" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Analog Input Scaling: 4 to 20 mA to 0 to 10 bar</text>
<line x1="110" y1="340" x2="710" y2="340" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<line x1="110" y1="340" x2="110" y2="90" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<line x1="110" y1="340" x2="710" y2="90" stroke="#059669" stroke-width="5"/>
<circle cx="110.0" cy="340.0" r="7" fill="#065f46"/>

<text x="260.0" y="370" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">8 mA</text>
<text x="96" y="283.5" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="end">2.5 bar</text>
<line x1="260.0" y1="340" x2="260.0" y2="277.5" stroke="#e5e7eb" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="4 4"/>
<circle cx="410.0" cy="215.0" r="7" fill="#065f46"/>
<text x="410.0" y="370" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">12 mA</text>
<text x="96" y="221.0" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="end">5 bar</text>
<line x1="410.0" y1="340" x2="410.0" y2="215.0" stroke="#e5e7eb" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="4 4"/>
<circle cx="560.0" cy="152.5" r="7" fill="#065f46"/>
<text x="560.0" y="370" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">16 mA</text>
<text x="96" y="158.5" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="end">7.5 bar</text>
<line x1="560.0" y1="340" x2="560.0" y2="152.5" stroke="#e5e7eb" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="4 4"/>
<circle cx="710.0" cy="90.0" r="7" fill="#065f46"/>
<text x="710.0" y="370" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">20 mA</text>
<text x="96" y="96.0" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="end">10 bar</text>
<line x1="710.0" y1="340" x2="710.0" y2="90.0" stroke="#e5e7eb" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="4 4"/>
<text x="410.0" y="402" font-size="18" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Transmitter current</text>
<rect x="130" y="62" width="330" height="80" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#059669" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="295.0" y="96.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Value = (mA minus 4) ÷ 16 × 10</text>
<text x="295.0" y="120.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Example: 12 mA gives 5 bar</text>
</svg>
